subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in Spanish on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (Spanish↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: What does “el estrés me agobia” mean?
questions.explain: “Agobiar” means “to overwhelm/stress out”, so “el estrés me agobia” = “stress overwhelms me”.
“Engordar” means “to put on weight / get fat”; the opposite is “adelgazar”.

questions.q: How do you say “I gave up sweets to be healthier”?
options: Dejo de comer dulces para estar más sano
Dejé de comer dulces para estar más sano
Empecé a comer dulces para estar más sano
Dejé de comer dulces para estar más enfermo
questions.explain: “Dejar de” + infinitive = “to give up/stop”, so “Dejé de comer dulces” = “I gave up eating sweets”.
'Embarazada' is a classic false friend: it means 'pregnant', not 'embarrassed' (which is 'avergonzado/a').

questions.q: How do you say 'I like playing the guitar'?
questions.explain: Instruments use 'tocar' (not 'jugar'); 'me gusta' + infinitive, so 'Me gusta tocar la guitarra'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'You must avoid sugary drinks'?
options: Hay que evitar las bebidas azucaradas
questions.explain: 'Hay que' = 'one must' and 'evitar' = 'to avoid', so 'Hay que evitar las bebidas azucaradas' = 'You must avoid sugary drinks'.

questions.q: How do you say “You should drink plenty of water”?
questions.explain: “Se debe” = “one should” and “beber” (not “comer”) is used for drinks: “Se debe beber mucha agua”.

questions.q: How do you say 'We celebrate my grandmother's birthday'?
options: Celebramos la Navidad de mi abuela
Celebro el cumpleaños de mi abuela
Celebramos el cumpleaños de mi abuela
Celebramos el cumpleaños de mi abuelo
questions.explain: 'Celebramos' = 'we celebrate' and 'de mi abuela' = 'my grandmother's', so the first option is correct.
'El bienestar' literally means 'being well' and translates as 'wellbeing'.
“Equilibrada” = balanced, so “una dieta equilibrada” = “a balanced diet”.

questions.q: How would you write 'limpio' to describe two beaches ('playas')?
questions.explain: 'Playa' is feminine, so the plural adjective is feminine plural: 'limpias'.

questions.q: How do you say “We exchange presents at Christmas”?
questions.explain: “Intercambiar” = to exchange and “regalos” = presents, so “Intercambiamos regalos en Navidad”.

questions.q: What does 'llevar una vida sana' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sano/a' means 'healthy', so 'llevar una vida sana' = 'to lead a healthy life'.

questions.q: What is 'La Tomatina', held in Buñol?
options: A festival where people throw tomatoes
questions.explain: 'La Tomatina' is a famous Spanish festival in which participants throw tomatoes at each other.
